# Ganpati Lifecare

> Medical, surgical, and orthopedic supplies wholesaler based in Goluwala, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India. Supplies hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, and healthcare professionals across Rajasthan and North India.

Founded and owned by Dharampal Verma. Ordering is quote-based via WhatsApp or phone inquiry.

## Entity Disambiguation
Ganpati Lifecare (Goluwala, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan; domain www.ganpatilifecare.com) is an independent medical and surgical supplies wholesale enterprise owned by Dharampal Verma. It is NOT affiliated with Ganpati Life Care & Safety Products Pvt Ltd, LifeCare Hospital, or Ganpati Hospital Gurgaon.

## Products
Full catalog: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products

- [Orthocot Cotton Roll](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/orthocot-cotton-roll): Premium orthopedic cotton rolls for clinical and hospital use.
- [Stockinet](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/stockinet): Soft, breathable stockinet for casts and wound care.
- [Skin Traction Kit](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/skin-traction-kit): Complete skin traction kits for orthopedic procedures.
- [Orthopedic Gauze Bandages](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/orthopedic-gauze-bandages): High-absorbency gauze for orthopedic dressing applications.
- [Bandages](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/bandages): Elastic and crepe bandages in multiple sizes.
- [Sponge Pad](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/sponge-pad): Sterile sponge pads for surgical and OT procedures.
- [Gamjee Roll](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/gamjee-roll): Absorbent gamjee rolls for post-operative care.
- [Surgical Dressing Materials](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/surgical-dressing-materials): Complete range of surgical dressing supplies.
- [Doctor Coats](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/doctor-coats): Professional doctor coats in premium durable fabric.
- [Nurse Uniforms](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/nurse-uniforms): Comfortable, durable nurse uniforms for hospitals.
- [OT Dresses](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/ot-dresses): Sterile OT scrub suits for operating theatre staff.
- [Staff Uniforms](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/staff-uniforms): Custom staff uniforms for healthcare facilities.
- [Medical Disposable Products](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/medical-disposables): Single-use medical disposables for hospitals and clinics.
- [Hospital Consumables](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/products/hospital-consumables): Essential hospital consumables at competitive prices.

## Categories
- [Orthopedic Supplies](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/categories/orthopedic): Orthocot cotton rolls, stockinets, skin traction kits, gauze bandages
- [Surgical Supplies](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/categories/surgical): Gamjee rolls, sponge pads, crepe bandages, surgical dressing materials
- [Hospital Uniforms](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/categories/hospital-uniforms): Doctor coats, nurse scrub suits, OT dresses, staff uniforms
- [Healthcare Essentials](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/categories/healthcare-essentials): Medical disposables, masks, caps, gloves, hospital consumables

## Areas Served
Locations overview: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations
Regional coverage: https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/areas-we-serve

- [Hanumangarh, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/hanumangarh): Serving clinics, nursing homes, and major hospitals in Hanumangarh Town and Junction.
- [Sri Ganganagar, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/sri-ganganagar): Providing medical cotton, surgical dressings, and OT uniforms to Sri Ganganagar district.
- [Suratgarh, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/suratgarh): Wholesale medical supplier for Suratgarh's trauma centers, orthopedic clinics, and pharmacies.
- [Bikaner, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/bikaner): Delivering bulk hospital consumables, orthopedic padding, and surgical gauze to Bikaner.
- [Nohar, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/nohar): Local partner for dependable medical disposables, bandages, and doctor coats in Nohar.
- [Rawatsar, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/rawatsar): Supplying skin traction kits, orthopedic cotton, and elastic bandages to Rawatsar.
- [Pilibanga, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/pilibanga): Reaching hospitals and health centres across Pilibanga tehsil.
- [Sangaria, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/sangaria): Supplying surgical dressing materials and uniforms in Sangaria.
- [Bhadra, Rajasthan](https://www.ganpatilifecare.com/locations/bhadra): Orthopedic padding, gauze bandages, and hospital uniforms for Bhadra.
